svg.title: 04 / Evidence, reports and safety observations
svg.desc: Logical ER model. Cardinalities are counts at each endpoint. EXPERIMENT_RUN (1) accumulates EXECUTION_EVIDENCE (0..N); EXPERIMENT_RUN (1) observed by STATE_OBSERVATION (0..N); ACTION_EXECUTION (0..1) optionally identifies EXECUTION_EVIDENCE (0..N); ACTION_EXECUTION (0..1) optionally identifies STATE_OBSERVATION (0..N); EXECUTION_EVIDENCE (0..1) may support STATE_OBSERVATION (0..N); EXPERIMENT_RUN (1) generates EXPERIMENT_REPORT (0..1); EXPERIMENT_REPORT (1) contains REPORT_ARTIFACT (0..N); EXPERIMENT_RUN (1) configures STOP_CONDITION (0..N); CLOUDWATCH_ALARM (0..1) referenced by STOP_CONDITION (0..N); CLOUDWATCH_ALARM (1) observed by ALARM_OBSERVATION (0..N); AWS_SCOPE (1) owns EXPERIMENT_RUN (0..N); AWS_SCOPE (1) has SAFETY_LEVER (1)
svg.text: Logical model | Endpoint labels show multiplicity | Source: canonical Mermaid
